description: This PHP source file defines the BearerTokenValidator class, which implements the AuthorizationValidatorInterface for validating OAuth2 Bearer tokens in the OrangeHRM system. It handles token extraction from HTTP headers, decryption, verification, revocation checks, and expiry validation.

classes.name: BearerTokenValidator
classes.description: A class implementing OAuth2 token validation logic, including extraction, decryption, verification, revocation check, and expiry validation for Bearer tokens.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with an access token repository and an encryption key.

methods.name: validateAuthorization
methods.description: Validates the Bearer token from the incoming HTTP request, performs decryption, verification, revocation check, and expiry validation, and attaches the access token to the request if successful.
